item.tib: tshogs skong ud dpal phreng rgyan
item.coloph: tshogs kyi skong tshig rnying bar yid ma shor/ tshogs bskang don 'thus ud dpal phreng brgyus pa/ tshogs gsog khye'u brgyan phyir dge bsod smras/ tshogs rdzogs rgyal ba'i spyan sngar nyer 'khod shog tsheg bar sum brgya drug cu'i gral bsgrigs nas/ shad bar bzhi bcu'i bkra shis rdzogs ston dge gso rig pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi (gyis) sug bris bzhengs pa/ 'gro kun sangs rgyas 'thob (thob) pa'i rgyu ru bsngo//
